write_needed_after_approval: create one dedicated Worker and SQLite class/namespace
put/delete only three named secrets and approved text bindings
invoke only the fixed instance management RPC through protected HTTP

operations: verify account and actual Free plan, SQLite availability
list/paginate Worker/DO/Cron metadata, names, URL, usage and permissions; store only relevant masked summaries
cf deploy --mode p51b-mock --provision=false using approved account and project-local authentication
create only candidate dedicated Worker, one SQLite class/namespace; no other binding resource types
upload control/report secrets, activate short-lived authenticated bridge with H01 init flag absent
read fixed instance identity and empty-storage eligibility; do not delete remnants
second cf deployment of same code and approved exact-object-ID/H01 policy only
call initializeIsolatedMock exactly once with complete command
read receipt/schema/audit; reject replay; if uncertain use readonly reconciliation, never re-init
delete init Secret and disable init flag, recording any implicit version/deployment effects
start fixed fixtures in order within window, no more than two runs
bounded platform Alarms commit synthetic state and counters
idempotent repeat start of existing fixture; readonly new stub/report/metrics checks
stop fixed object and cancel its Alarm; verify persisted STOPPED and stable counters
export masked evidence and actual per-resource metrics
revoke control/report Secret and any init capability
retain stopped dedicated Worker/namespace/storage for review; no remote deletion authorized by this draft

pre_deploy_requirements: temporary HTTP admin bridge explicitly approved
all generated bindings/resources match this manifest
free eligibility and remaining shared quotas adequate
existing approved workers.dev subdomain; do not create or modify an account-level subdomain

checks: 90 repeated early ticks stop at80, no recollect

actions: persist STOPPED and cancel only target Alarm
revoke three named secrets and init flag

cleanup.rollback: stop and revoke scoped credentials without resetting state or reinitializing; emergency dedicated-Worker disable only if explicitly approved; never touch other projects
